caption: The drawing presents a rectangular composition with a background of light tan color bordered by irregular, wave-like brown shapes along all four sides. Three large, circular floral motifs are arranged vertically in the center, evenly spaced, each with green, red, and yellow petals radiating outward and an inner structure of green circles and red lines. In between and around these central flowers are smaller bud shapes, predominantly yellow with red and green accents, attached to curving red and brown stems. Additionally, there are green and maroon leaves with intricate yellow and green detailing, also attached to the central stem. The overall arrangement creates a symmetrical, vertically-aligned floral pattern against the contrasting tan background. There is a handwritten signature, “Ruth M. Barnes,” in the lower right corner, and a handwritten code or number in the lower left.
title: Quilt (Section)
